title: Photovoltaic Defect Image Generator With Boundary Alignment Smoothing Constraint for Domain Shift Mitigation (PDIG)
mechanism: Stable Diffusion with a semantic concept embedding, a lightweight industrial style adaptor via cross-disentangled attention, and text-image dual-space constraints that place defects in given boxes.
adaptation: Box-level only; use as EL evidence that synthesis helps under a time/domain shift and as an EL generator baseline; boxes could seed crack masks only via a separate mask model.
min_experiment: No score experiment proposed; cite in the benchmark and, if code appears, run as a baseline generator for inactive at matched count vs row 2 on CV inactive IoU.
evidence: R: FID 20.90 average over 5 EL defect types vs 40.06 StyleGAN3; 200 generated images per type raised YOLOv5 mAP by 5.8 and 6.3 points on time-shifted EL group2 and group3 (ELES dataset, 16,323 images); YOLOv8 +1.8.
